_O23ZrgT4z3_SBc_TIlw-Q.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年7/31累計145國/地區報告19萬683例確定病例,其中529例死亡。 今年7月共計32國家/地區報告1,370例確定病例,其中7例死亡(CFR:0.5%),以馬達加斯加(703例)、安哥拉(138例)、中國(88 例)、剛果⺠主共和國(55例)及肯亞(55例)為多,74.8%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年6月,全球病例數下降12.5%,僅非洲區呈上升趨勢,其餘地區下降;東南亞區及東地中海區則無通報病例。 全球已有68個國家/地區曾通報檢出Clade Ib確定病例,近6週(7/6-8/16)共有22國報告病例,其中15國出現本土社區傳播疫情,分布於非洲6國(馬達加斯加、安哥拉、肯亞、剛果⺠主共和國、南蘇丹、蒲隆地)及歐洲9國(葡萄牙、德國、法國、英國、愛爾蘭、荷蘭、義大利、瑞士及捷克)。 另馬達加斯加自2025年12月起迄今爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情。
_O23ZrgT4z3_SBc_TIlw-Q.en: Globally, since 2022 and as of 31 July this year, 145 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 190,683 confirmed cases, including 529 deaths. In July this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,370 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths (CFR 0.5%); the largest numbers were in Madagascar (703), Angola (138), China (88), the DRC (55) and Kenya (55), and 74.8% of cases came from Africa. Compared with June this year, global cases fell by 12.5%; only Africa showed an increase, while other regions declined, and no cases were reported from South-East Asia or the Eastern Mediterranean region. A total of 68 countries and territories have ever reported confirmed clade Ib cases. In the past six weeks (6 July–16 August), 22 countries reported cases, of which 15 have local community transmission: six in Africa (Madagascar, Angola, Kenya, the DRC, South Sudan and Burundi) and nine in Europe (Portugal, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Netherlands, Italy, Switzerland and Czechia). Madagascar has been experiencing the largest clade Ib outbreak in the world since December 2025.

U6KDJdnwBzrqnJZbLUeMvg.zh: WHO於今年5/14召開第45次IHR小兒麻痺症緊急委員會並於8/25公布決議,今年截至4/30全球累積報告16例WPV1病例、2 例cVDPV1病例、28例cVDPV2病例及2例cVDPV3病例。環境樣本部分:累計報告74件WPV1、27件cVDPV2。考量全球疫情傳播及疫苗覆蓋率,評估持續構成國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),並再延⻑臨時性措施3個月,惟不構成緊急大流行(Pandemic Emergency),並建議有11個國家(有WPV1、cVDPV1、cVDPV3傳播風險者)需加強疫情監測及疫苗接種等措施,包括有WPV1疫情之阿富汗、巴基斯坦、德國,有cVDPV1 疫情之阿爾及利亞、剛果⺠主共和國、吉布地、以色列、寮國,有cVDPV3疫情之喀麥隆、查德、奈及利亞;另建議24個有cVDPV2國內傳播風險的國家加強防治措施。由於核疫區的持續傳播、偏鄉與衝突地區疫苗接種覆蓋率不均以及頻繁的跨國人口流動,WPV1及cVDPV仍具有高度國際傳播風險 。 WHO於8/19宣布非洲5國cVDPV2疫情已終止,分別為蒲隆地 、迦納、幾內亞比索、剛果共和國及烏干達。當局近年透過資金與技術支援、加強疫苗接種,強化急性無力肢體麻痺監測與實驗室檢驗能力,以及應用地理資訊系統的成功阻斷疫情。
U6KDJdnwBzrqnJZbLUeMvg.en: WHO convened the 45th IHR Emergency Committee on polio on 14 May this year and published its decision on 25 August. As of 30 April this year, 16 WPV1 cases, 2 cVDPV1 cases, 28 cVDPV2 cases and 2 cVDPV3 cases had been reported worldwide. For environmental samples, 74 WPV1 and 27 cVDPV2 detections had been reported cumulatively. Considering global transmission and vaccination coverage, the committee assessed that polio continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), extended temporary recommendations by 3 months, but does not constitute a Pandemic Emergency. It recommended that 11 countries at risk of WPV1, cVDPV1 or cVDPV3 transmission strengthen surveillance and vaccination: Afghanistan, Pakistan and Germany (WPV1 outbreaks); Algeria, the DRC, Djibouti, Israel and Laos (cVDPV1 outbreaks); and Cameroon, Chad and Nigeria (cVDPV3 outbreaks). It also recommended that 24 countries at risk of domestic cVDPV2 transmission strengthen control measures. Owing to continued transmission in endemic areas, uneven vaccination coverage in remote and conflict-affected areas, and frequent cross-border population movement, WPV1 and cVDPV remain at high risk of international spread. WHO declared on 19 August that cVDPV2 outbreaks had ended in five African countries: Burundi, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, the Republic of the Congo and Uganda. In recent years, these outbreaks were stopped through financial and technical support, enhanced vaccination, strengthened acute flaccid paralysis surveillance and laboratory capacity, and the use of geographic information systems.

9kcLAdugkK5hvDJECYo3pw.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,6/25新增48例確定病例,其中11例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(42例)及北基伍省(6例)。迄6/25累計1,203例確定病例(321例死亡、148例康復),致死率26.7%,疫情主要集中在東部伊圖里(1,096例)、北基伍(104例) 及南基伍省(3例)共34個衛生區,接觸者追蹤率約82.8%。 烏干達自6/21新增1例確定病例後,迄無新增疫情,迄6/27累計20例確定病例(2例死亡、15例康復),其中15例為境外移入、5 例為本土病例。個案分布於首都坎帕拉(Kampala)及瓦基索區(Wakiso),均與跨境移動及醫療照護暴露有關,尚無社區傳播疫情。 WHO非洲區署依據DRC截至6/8的累計598例確定病例數作SEIRD隨機數理模型推估,預測DRC至9/16將達8,210例確定病例(其中1,440例死亡)。推估截至8/12對烏干達造成至少1例境外移入的可能性為94.2%,其次為南蘇丹(可能性69.3%)、盧安達(可能性8.6%)、蒲隆地(可能性2%)。
9kcLAdugkK5hvDJECYo3pw.en: The DRC continues to report new cases. On 25 June, 48 new confirmed cases were added, including 11 deaths, in Ituri Province (42 cases) and North Kivu Province (6). As of 25 June, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 1,203 (321 deaths, 148 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 26.7%. The outbreak is mainly concentrated in the eastern provinces of Ituri (1,096 cases), North Kivu (104) and South Kivu (3), across 34 health zones. The contact tracing rate is about 82.8%. Uganda has reported no new cases since adding one on 21 June. As of 27 June, 20 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 15 recoveries), of which 15 were imported and 5 were local cases. The cases are in the capital, Kampala, and Wakiso District, all related to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure, and there is no community transmission. The WHO Regional Office for Africa, using a SEIRD stochastic model based on the DRC's cumulative total of 598 confirmed cases as of 8 June, projects that the DRC will reach 8,210 confirmed cases by 16 September, including 1,440 deaths. The model estimates a 94.2% probability that Uganda will have at least one imported case by 12 August, followed by South Sudan (69.3%), Rwanda (8.6%) and Burundi (2%).

QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情持續擴大,截至5/24累計報告112例確診及11例死亡、906例疑病例及223例疑病例死亡,主要分布於伊圖里省、北基伍省及南基伍省;烏干達迄今累積報告7例確診,其中1例死亡;義大利出現2例疑病例,在烏干達擔任為期三個月的援助工作人員,返回義國後,出現高燒、嘔吐、腹瀉和噁心等疑症狀,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。非洲CDC評估有11個國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、南蘇丹、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、坦尚亞、尚比亞及索馬利亞。
QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.en: The outbreak in the DRC continues to expand: as of 24 May, 112 confirmed cases and 11 deaths, plus 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths, had been reported cumulatively, mainly in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda has reported seven confirmed cases cumulatively, one of which was fatal. Italy reported two suspected cases involving an aid worker who had spent three months in Uganda. After returning to Italy, the person developed suspected symptoms including high fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and nausea, but tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases in Italy. The Africa CDC assesses that 11 countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, South Sudan, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Zambia and Somalia.

sncrUtYerCGCwrfk3ZssMA.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)及烏干達疫情持續擴大,疫情主要分布於DRC伊圖里與北基伍省,兩國截至5/23累計報告91例確診及10例死亡、867例疑病例及204例疑病例死亡,且匡列1,261名接觸者。DRC伊圖里省傳出3名紅十字會志工染病死亡,南基伍省(South Kivu)亦於5/20通報首例28歲死亡確診個案。烏干達迄今累積報告5例確診,其中1例死亡。另南蘇丹澄清其境內疑病例,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。 WHO指出疫情在5/15通報前恐已隱匿傳播數週或數月,導致疫情蔓延至多個省份。非洲CDC評估有10個非洲國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、南蘇丹、坦尚亞及尚比亞。 WHO緊急委員會第一次會議臨時建議,評估剛果民主共和國風險為「非常高」,烏干達及區域風險為「高」,全球風險為「低」。建議疫區國家啟動國家災害或突發事件管理機制,並執行包括加強監測等防控措施;區域層級國家應建立與地方各層級相銜接的國家協調機制制定相關措施;其他國家對來自已記錄到病毒(BDBV)感染地區出現不明原因發熱症狀的旅行者進行檢測、評估、報告及管理,執行公眾之疫情風險溝通等。
sncrUtYerCGCwrfk3ZssMA.en: The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda continues to expand, mainly in Ituri and North Kivu provinces of the DRC. As of 23 May, the two countries had reported 91 confirmed cases and 10 deaths, 867 suspected cases and 204 suspected deaths, and 1,261 contacts had been listed. In Ituri Province, DRC, three Red Cross volunteers were reported to have died after infection. South Kivu Province reported its first confirmed case, a death in a 28-year-old, on 20 May. Uganda has reported five cumulative confirmed cases, one of which was fatal. South Sudan clarified that a suspected case in its territory tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases there. WHO notes that the outbreak may have spread silently for several weeks or months before it was reported on 15 May, leading to spread across multiple provinces. The Africa CDC assesses that 10 African countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania and Zambia. The first meeting of the WHO Emergency Committee provisionally assessed the risk as very high for the DRC, high for Uganda and at regional level, and low globally. It recommends that affected countries activate national disaster or emergency management mechanisms and implement control measures, including enhanced surveillance; that countries in the region establish national coordination mechanisms linked to local levels; and that other countries test, assess, report and manage travellers with unexplained fever who have been in areas where Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) infection has been recorded, and communicate public health risks.

qKUxc6-Q6_UeTClgmVK8Jw.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今年3/31累計144國/地區報告18萬2,945例確診病例,其中,至少503例死亡。 今年3月共計48國家/地區報告1,235 例新增確診病例,其中5例死亡(CFR 0.4%),70.4%的病例來自非洲地區,相較今年2月,東地中海及西太平洋區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降,哥倫比亞、丹麥、厄瓜多和新加坡通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/3/9-4/19)共計16國通報969例確診病例,其中3例死亡(CFR 0.3%),以馬達加斯加、剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、肯亞、蒲隆地為高;非洲以外地區,阿根廷、丹麥、德國、巴基斯坦、葡萄牙、新加坡、西班牙及英國已持續出現Ib型社區傳播。 巴基斯坦信德省通報一起院內群聚事件(前已掌握),傳播原因主要為共用保溫箱、氧氣設備及設備表面受污染。在3至4月期間,該省9縣(/30縣)共29例確診與8例死亡(CFR 28%),死亡個案均為6個月以下嬰兒,基因定序確認為Ib型變異株。
qKUxc6-Q6_UeTClgmVK8Jw.en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 31 March this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 182,945 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 503 died. In March this year, 48 countries and territories reported 1,235 new confirmed cases, including five deaths (CFR 0.4%). 70.4% of cases came from the African region. Compared with February, cases rose in the Eastern Mediterranean and Western Pacific regions and fell in other regions. Colombia, Denmark, Ecuador and Singapore reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African region, over the past six weeks (9 March–19 April), 16 countries reported 969 confirmed cases, including three deaths (CFR 0.3%), with the highest numbers in Madagascar, the DRC, Guinea, Kenya and Burundi. Outside Africa, Argentina, Denmark, Germany, Pakistan, Portugal, Singapore, Spain and the United Kingdom have continued to show clade Ib community transmission. Sindh Province in Pakistan reported a hospital cluster (already known), with transmission mainly attributed to shared incubators and oxygen equipment and contaminated equipment surfaces. In March and April, the province's nine of 30 districts recorded 29 confirmed cases and eight deaths (CFR 28%). All deaths were in infants under six months, and genetic sequencing confirmed a clade Ib variant.

BfLG48AMi_iKcBkzKIC2-g.zh: 蒲隆地北部姆潘達區自 3/31 起通報不明原因疾病,至少 5 例死亡及35 例病例,病例僅限於同一家庭成員及其密切接觸者,症狀包括發燒、頭痛、極度疲勞、腹痛、嘔吐、腹瀉及血尿,嚴重病例出現貧血及黃疸,實驗室已排除伊波拉病毒、馬堡病毒、黃熱病、裂谷熱及克里米亞-剛果出血熱,調查仍在進行中。該地區鄰近剛果民主共和國邊境,除不易進行跨境監測,亦可能出現未被發現的病例。
BfLG48AMi_iKcBkzKIC2-g.en: Since 31 March, an unexplained illness has been reported in Mpanda, in the north of Burundi, with at least 5 deaths and 35 cases. Cases are limited to members of the same family and their close contacts. Symptoms include fever, headache, extreme fatigue, abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhoea and haematuria; severe cases showed anaemia and jaundice. Laboratory testing has ruled out Ebola virus, Marburg virus, yellow fever, Rift Valley fever and Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever. The investigation is ongoing. The area borders the Democratic Republic of the Congo; cross-border surveillance is difficult, and undetected cases may also occur.

GmQvkuk1n4YSJS05K7Vxmg.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今年2/28累計144國/地區報告18萬1千餘例確診病例,其中,至少492例死亡。 今年2月共計46國家/地區報告1,184 例新增確診病例,其中4例死亡,58.6%來自非洲地區,相較今年1月,歐洲區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降或持平,阿根廷、奧地利及中非共和國通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/2/1-3/15)共計17國通報907例確診病例,其中7例死亡,以馬達加斯加、剛果民主共和國、肯亞、蒲隆地及賴比瑞亞為高;非洲以外地區,奧地利、比利時、葡萄牙、西班牙及英國已持續出現Ib型社區傳播。
GmQvkuk1n4YSJS05K7Vxmg.en: Monthly update: Since 2022 and up to 28 February this year, 144 countries and regions have reported more than 181,000 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 492 died. In February this year, 46 countries and regions reported 1,184 new confirmed cases, including 4 deaths; 58.6% came from the African Region. Compared with January this year, case numbers rose in the European Region, while other regions declined or held steady. Argentina, Austria and the Central African Republic reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the past six weeks (1 February–15 March 2026), 17 countries reported 907 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths; the highest numbers were in Madagascar, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Burundi and Liberia. Outside Africa, Austria, Belgium, Portugal, Spain and the United Kingdom have continued to report clade Ib community transmission.

c4ZCwXOI9KsgYmY6OaV0Ag.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年5/29累計133國/地區報告14萬2,367例確診病例,其中至少325例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第22週累計74國/地區報告2萬1,655例確診病例,其中,非洲區1萬8,107例、美洲區1,787例、西太平洋區477例、歐洲區1218例、東南亞區37例及東地中海區29例。  其他更新:  非洲烏干達近幾週疫情呈下降趨勢,惟仍嚴峻,每週新增病例數約200例;蒲隆地每週新增病例數持續少於50例。WHO表示剛果民主共和國迄今仍為非洲疫情最嚴重之國家,由於檢測和確診能力下降,可能低報病例數,應審慎評估疫情趨勢。  評估與建議:  WHO於2025/2/25召開針對2024年M痘疫情的IHR緊急委員會第三次會議,表示目前疫情仍嚴峻,剛果民主共和國(DRC)等國疫情規模仍不明確,且國際間報告Ib分支感染國家數倍增,又因資金援助刪減,影響疫苗及診斷資源可近性,故宣布此波疫情持續構成「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」。
c4ZCwXOI9KsgYmY6OaV0Ag.en: Monthly update: as of 29 May this year, 133 countries and regions have reported 142,367 confirmed mpox cases cumulatively since May 2022, including at least 325 deaths (CFR 0.2%). As of week 22 this year, 74 countries and regions have reported 21,655 confirmed cases cumulatively this year: 18,107 in the African Region, 1,787 in the Region of the Americas, 477 in the Western Pacific Region, 1,218 in the European Region, 37 in the South-East Asia Region and 29 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Other updates: in Africa, the outbreak in Uganda has declined in recent weeks but remains severe, with about 200 new cases per week; new weekly cases in Burundi have remained below 50. WHO says the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains the most affected country in Africa; because testing and diagnostic capacity has declined, case numbers may be underreported, so trends should be assessed with caution. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the third meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on the 2024 mpox outbreak on 25 February 2025. It stated that the outbreak remains severe, the scale of the outbreak in countries including the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains unclear, the number of countries reporting clade Ib infections has multiplied internationally, and reduced funding is affecting access to vaccines and diagnostic resources. It therefore declared that this wave of the outbreak continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

5zbcXF18D6vXj_gmNKqCjw.zh: 依ACDC統計,非洲今年截至12/16累計20國報告65,947例病例,其中14,394例確診,1,239例死亡(CFR:1.88%),以剛果民主共和國報告10,533例確診最為嚴峻,蒲隆地2,402例次之,烏干達925例疫情明顯上升,其餘各國報告1至118例不等。 ACDC 12/19表示,預計下週取得首批5萬劑LC16疫苗,2月起並將陸續到貨300萬劑,該疫苗可用於1歲以上兒童,可填補目前兒童疫苗接種無法涵蓋之族群。
5zbcXF18D6vXj_gmNKqCjw.en: According to Africa CDC statistics, as of 16 December this year, 20 countries in Africa had reported 65,947 cases cumulatively, including 14,394 confirmed and 1,239 deaths (CFR 1.88%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 10,533 confirmed cases, is the most severely affected; Burundi, with 2,402 cases, ranks second, and Uganda, with 925 cases, shows a marked increase. The remaining countries reported between 1 and 118 cases each. Africa CDC stated on 19 December that it expects to receive the first 50,000 doses of LC16 vaccine the following week, with 3 million doses to arrive in batches from February. The vaccine can be used in children over one year old, filling a gap in populations not covered by current childhood vaccination.

Hqxm_LoYSKmQ37Zau5Hq4Q.en: According to Africa CDC statistics, as of 29 November this year, 20 countries in Africa had reported 62,789 cases cumulatively, including 13,848 confirmed and 1,204 deaths (CFR 1.85%). Viet Nam: In Ho Chi Minh City, the outbreak continues to rise, with weekly new cases exceeding 200. As of 22 November this year, more than 1,800 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 3 deaths, and authorities have stepped up vaccination measures.

Kyrgyzstan: As of September this year, 13,358 cases have been cumulatively reported. The outbreak peaked in June and has declined since, and is now slowing. Cases are mainly distributed in the northern and south-western regions, and authorities have stepped up vaccination.

Africa: The outbreak continues. As of 8 November this year, 232,363 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 21,214 confirmed cases and 3,136 deaths (CFR: 1.35%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo has been most severely affected, reporting more than 92,000 cases. Ethiopia, Burundi, Morocco, Somalia, Nigeria and Burkina Faso each reported between 1 and more than 28,000 cases; Chad and Côte d'Ivoire reported 7,000 to more than 8,000 cases; and 21 countries reported from several dozen to 5,000 cases.

According to Africa CDC, across Africa as of 8 November this year, 20 countries have cumulatively reported 55,413 cases, including 12,162 confirmed cases and 1,142 deaths (CFR: 2.06%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo is the most severely affected, reporting 9,456 confirmed cases, followed by Burundi with 1,834 cases. Uganda, with 443 cases, has seen a marked rise in its outbreak, and the remaining countries reported between 1 and 118 cases each.

Manitoba Province, Canada, reported the country's first clade Ib case on 22 November. The patient had recently travelled to an African country with ongoing outbreaks, is in isolation, and contacts are being traced. Authorities assess the risk to the general public as still low.

8CygmkAcw-4zLDIan3Gvsw.en:
California, United States, reported its first clade I case on 16 November. The patient had travel history to Africa and is isolated at home. Authorities have traced related contacts, and there are no signs of ongoing transmission so far.

Clade Ib outbreaks continue in Africa. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Burundi, transmission was originally mostly through sexual contact among young people; as the affected population has expanded, transmission has shifted to household and community spread, and the proportion of young children infected has also risen. In Uganda, the outbreak has risen markedly recently, with infection mostly through sexual contact.

Africa CDC, on 6 November, worked with a biotechnology company to launch trials of the smallpox drug brincidofovir (TEMBEXA) for treating Mpox.

YwWx3qmKFFHfXZLXHGq3Qg.en: Africa has cumulatively reported 45,672 cases in 18 countries so far this year as of 18 October, including 9,298 confirmed cases and 1,014 deaths. The Democratic Republic of the Congo is the most severely affected, with 7,517 confirmed cases (1,005 deaths), followed by Burundi with 1,287 cases. The remaining countries reported between 1 and 152 cases each. In the region, the testing rate was about 52.8% and the positivity rate was 36.2%.

Mi7mhyVVSmRwhe_K3pD3jQ.en: The outbreak in Africa continues. As of 26 September this year, 218,258 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 19,454 were confirmed and 2,968 died (CFR: 1.25%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo (over 85,000) and Ethiopia (over 27,000) account for the most cases. Burundi, Morocco, Nigeria, Burkina Faso and Somalia each reported over 10,000 cases, Chad and Côte d'Ivoire reported 7,000 to 8,000 cases, and 19 countries reported between several dozen and 5,000 cases. In southern Viet Nam, cases in Ho Chi Minh City have risen. Nearly 100 new cases were reported in the last week of September, and since the outbreak began (date unspecified), 743 cases have been reported cumulatively as of 26 September, mostly children under 5. Authorities say immunization coverage differs widely across districts in the city and currently exceeds 72%. Media reports also indicate that cases are rising in central and northern provinces of the country.
